text: After waiting 5 months to have our case opened, we found out that I need to get a certificate of good conduct from Germany, where I was an Erasmus student 10 years ago (which can take up to 4 months to get). I literally got the first flight to go there and get it, but today we also got a message, that my Polish documents (personal status, good conduct) are gonna expired in few days and I have to get new ones... Can they actually do something like this? How is it our fault that it took them so long to open our case and the documents expired???
